releaseName: Flora V3.1 — 用途说明、AI 标识与页面文案更新
changes: Entertainment/self-exploration notices for daily card results, Yes/No results, deep readings and saved follow-ups.
Yes/No order: result, deep-reading invitation, content notice; no input-page notice.
Deep setup notice follows spread/options and precedes start button.
AI labels, including legacy online readings without model names; no history rewrite.
Daily check-in and petal top-up wording; matching metadata and policy labels.
Main and follow-up prompts identify an AI card-reading assistant for entertainment and self-exploration.
